title: Micron ships HBM4 memory for Nvidia's Vera Rubin

sources.quote: Micron Technology, Inc., has begun volume shipment of its HBM4 36GB 12H in the first quarter of calendar year 2026 and is designed for Nvidia Vera Rubin.
Micron Technology has begun volume shipment of its HBM4 36GB 12H in the first quarter of calendar year 2026 and is designed for Nvidia Vera Rubin.

explain: Micron began volume shipments of its next-generation HBM4 memory designed for Nvidia's Vera Rubin AI platform in early 2026, so Nvidia is paying Micron for this memory. The value was not disclosed.
